subject.title: West Basin Municipal Water District Board, Division 2

text: I respectfully ask for your vote for the West Basin Municipal Water District Board.

I bring decades of public service and proven leadership advocating for strong, healthy, and resilient communities. At West Basin, I have worked to protect our water supply, strengthen infrastructure, promote conservation, and prepare our region for drought, climate change, and future growth.
Water is essential to every
family, business, and community. I will champion reliable and affordable water while supporting responsible investments that protect our resources for future generations.
My leadership is grounded in listening, accountability, collaboration, and results. I understand the needs of local communities and the regional challenges facing Southern California's water future.
West Basin deserves experienced, independent leadership committed to protecting ratepayers and our water resources.
This November, I ask for your vote and the opportunity to serve with integrity, experience,
and results.

text: I'm Tyron Turner, and I want to represent you on the West Basin Water Board.
This is the job I want, and the only job I want.
Affordability is the biggest issue facing our families today. For the past 5 years, water rates have climbed between 10-15% year after year. I won't support those increases.
If elected I will deliver:
- Clean, safe, affordable drinking water
- Lower water rates
- Sustainable water solutions for our future
Today, I serve as an advisor on a local water board, giving me firsthand experience protecting one of our community's most essential resources.
I'm a longtime Inglewood resident and a proud SEIU Local 2015 member.
I attended Southwest Community College and went on to receive my Bachelor's and Master's degree from California State University, Dominguez Hills.
I'm proud to have the support of WRD Board Member Joy Langford, Former County Supervisor Yvonne Brathwaite Burke, Inglewood Mayor James Butts, and Councilman Alex Padilla.
If you want someone 100% focused on clean, safe, affordable water, I'm your candidate.
I respectfully ask for your vote for West Basin Water District, Division 2, and I'll keep your rates as low as possible.
